metadata.description: Claude Code plugins collection by alanceloth — PR Review Orchestrator and audited mods

plugins.name: pr-review-orchestrator
plugins.description: Meta-orchestrator that dynamically discovers all installed review specialist agents, dispatches them in parallel for PR reviews, and aggregates findings into a single consolidated PR comment.

plugins.name: agentpane
plugins.description: Pane lateral com os subagentes da sessão: ferramenta atual, tokens e conversa (vendorizado de xuanji86/claude-agentpane)

plugins.name: cc-pr-tracker
plugins.description: PRs observados acima do prompt: merge state, review e checks obrigatórios (vendorizado de sezaakgun/cc-pr-tracker, defaults mais conservadores)

plugins.name: ts-band
plugins.description: Nós do Tailscale acima do prompt com aviso quando um cai ou vai pra relay (vendorizado de hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods)
